# Safe and Sound Security

> > Professional security system installation, monitoring, and integration services specializing in access control, CCTV surveillance, and commercial security solutions across the United States.

Safe and Sound Security is an authorized installer and dealer for major security brands including Hikvision, DSX Access Systems, NEC, and Microsoft Teams. The company provides comprehensive security solutions from alarm monitoring to enterprise-scale multi-site deployments, with expertise in structured cabling, building management systems, and access control technologies.

- [National Multi-Site Rollout Solutions](https://getsafeandsound.com/national-multi-site-rollout): National multi-site security system deployment and project management
